description: Unit (packages/tickets/src/lib, resolveCommentAuthor): authorless + is_system_generated → source 'system'; authorless + !is_system_generated → 'unknown'; resolvable user with is_system_generated → 'user' (system never overrides a real author)

Contract (packages/ui SystemAvatar.test.tsx): no initials text rendered; role=img with the given aria-label; glyph='bundle' vs 'system' picks different svg; data-avatar-kind set; xs renders rounded-md, md renders rounded-full

Component (CommentItem.bundledUpdate.test.tsx, rewritten): authorless mirror with bundle_mirror_source {master id+number} → SystemAvatar data-avatar-kind='bundle', no 'UU', name 'Bundled update', chip link href /msp/tickets/{id} with text 'Bundled update from MSTR-9', no email line
Component (CommentItem.bundledUpdate.test.tsx): authorless mirror with bundle_mirror_source {source_comment_id only} (portal shape) → bundle avatar, chip is a span with text 'Bundled update', no link
Component (CommentItem.bundledUpdate.test.tsx): resolvable-author mirror → real initials 'AS', author name, chip 'Bundled update from MSTR-9' linked; no SystemAvatar

Component (new CommentItem.systemAuthor.test.tsx): is_system_generated, user_id null, no bundle_mirror_source (Huntress shape) → SystemAvatar data-avatar-kind='system', name 'System', no bundled-update chip, no 'UU'; compact variant renders the sm size

Component (CommentItem.inboundAuthorAvatar.test.tsx, extended): unresolvable non-system comment with no sender metadata → 'UU' + 'Unknown User' unchanged; with sender metadata → sender initials unchanged

Integration (server/src/test/integration/ticketBundling.integration.test.ts, extended): after a sync_updates mirror and an apply_resolution mirror whose source comment is authorless, getConsolidatedTicketData(child).comments[…].bundle_mirror_source has source_comment_id, master_ticket_id and master_ticket_number; the child row's user_id/contact_id stay null (no re-attribution); a non-mirrored comment on the same ticket has bundle_mirror_source null

Integration (ticketBundlingPortalAuthor.integration.test.ts, extended): getClientTicketDetails(child) mirrored comment has bundle_mirror_source.source_comment_id set and master_ticket_id/master_ticket_number absent; contract assertion that the portal query selects no tickets/master columns
Contract (optimizedTicketActions.tenantScopedAuth.contract.test.ts, extended): the provenance joins in the comments query use tenantLeftJoin / tenantScopedTable (Citus co-location)

Unit (server/src/test/unit/i18n/pseudoLocalesInSync + validate-translations via npm run test:i18n): conversation.systemAuthor and conversation.bundledUpdateFrom present in all locales with matching {{number}} placeholder
Unit (ticketService.updateComment / commentActions): an update payload carrying bundle_mirror_source is ignored/rejected and never written
